page_title: Open Source Alternatives to Popular Software

sources.entry: Open Alternative - Discover Open Source Alternatives to Popular Software. A curated collection of the best open source alternatives to everyday SaaS products. Save money with reliable tools hand-picked for you.

summary.name: Open Alternative
summary.one_liner: A directory of open source alternatives to popular proprietary software and SaaS products, listing projects with their star counts, last commit dates, and licenses.
use_cases: Finding a self-hostable replacement for a paid SaaS tool
Comparing open source projects by stars, license and activity
Browsing open source AI agent platforms
Discovering privacy-focused alternatives to commercial apps
summary.what_it_does: The page is a curated directory that pairs open source projects with the commercial products they are alternatives to. Each entry shows a short description, GitHub star count, days since last commit, and license type (for example AGPL-3.0, MIT, Apache-2.0). Entries are grouped under category headings such as AI agent platforms, low-code platforms, web analytics, team chat, CRM and password/authentication tools. The listing also includes category counts and growth figures for groups of tools. The page itself is a catalogue rather than a single tool, and the descriptions it shows come from the listed projects.
notable: Lists star counts, last commit time and license for each project
Groups alternatives by category such as AI agents, CRM, analytics and chat
Listed in the awesome-mac 'Genuine Sites' section
caveats: Pricing of the listed projects is not stated on this page; some licenses are shown as unknown
The page is a directory, so the listed tools are separate projects with their own platforms and limits
Contains advertising for a third-party product (CodeRabbit)
